versions.changelog: AI智能摘要、验证码高亮、智能预览、断点续传防重复

Initial release of qq-email-watcher.

- Monitors new emails from QQ mailbox whitelist contacts and sends proactive QQ message notifications.
- Supports configurable polling interval, whitelist/blacklist management, and email content preview.
- Simple setup via JSON configuration files.
- Includes daily operations guide for status checking, whitelist updates, and service management.
